desc: Ideate approaches and identify the telescoping transformation to a one-dimensional shortest-path-style DP as the preferred first solution.
Implement the transformed one-dimensional O(n^2) DP: `dp[0] = 0`, `dp[b] = min_{a < b} dp[a] + P[b] * (C[b] - C[a]) + k * (C[n] - C[a])`, and return `dp[n]`.
Test the implementation against the provided examples and edge cases such as `n = 1`, one whole-array subarray, and all singleton subarrays.
If sample tests fail, debug the transformation/DP or switch to a different approach.
